title: Hatsune Miku — An Evolving Tone〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's almost time.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, it is. Also, I'm glad the weather turned out so nice.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're lucky Luka charm really did the trick, didn't it?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Maybe... Oh!
I think they're calling us!
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting, Miku, Luka, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. Don't mind us. We've just been chatting the whole time.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <If anything, we should be the ones thanking you for inviting us.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm so glad that you guys could come along to see the cherry blossoms with us!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh... Luka, MEIKO, look!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Wow! They really are in full bloom...!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, they're so beautiful.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Right?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, let's get our cherry blossom viewing picnic started!

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Saki & Honami & Shiho
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa! Hona, this is amazing!
Fried chicken, omelets and bite-size Salisbury steaks!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Mmm... These Salisbury steaks are so good.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I made plenty so have as much as you like.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I made some rice balls too if anyone would like some...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I'm glad Ichika's having such a good time...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Hm? Is something wrong, Luka?)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: How many have you had already, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Not sure. I just don't want to miss out on these.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Could it be something about Shiho...?)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Luka, is something about Shiho worrying you?>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Sometimes, very occasionally, she'll have this sad look on her face and I was wondering what it could be about...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I think I know what you mean. One minute she seems completely focused on practice, but has the somber look on her the next...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <You two already noticed...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I'm sure Ichika has as well...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Right. That was sort of the reason why Ichika started training in secret.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <What do you mean by that?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Ichika's under the impression that she hasn't reached the level Shiho wants her to be at yet, but wants Shiho to be able to play to her heart's content.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <That's why she's been trying to find ways to get better by practicing in secret.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I didn't know that...>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I'm not sure what's on Shiho's mind...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (But for now, I want them to have as much fun as possible.)
bgm_area00001
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Whew! That picnic was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It was, and the cherry blossoms were as beautiful as ever. I'm glad the girls were able to enjoy themselves without thinking about anything else too.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I agree. It's almost a bit of a shame that the day's already over.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right. It's sort of a bittersweet ending.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: How about we play something instead?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay! Just give me a second to get ready!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: One, two, three, four...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Luka always creates such a good groove for us...!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
(Hehe. MEIKO's playing great too!
I need to do the same...!)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Phew... That was a pretty amazing session!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, it was. I think we were all able to play just the way we wanted to as well.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: How does another song sound? I feel like we can play anything right now!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Eep..!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Your string...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Miku, are you okay? You're not hurt, are you?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, no. It just surprised me is all...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: *Sigh*... Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But that's so strange. I just restrung it a little while ago...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Was I strumming too hard then?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I don't think you were...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I have a bad feeling about this...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Miku, is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I wouldn't put too much stock into it. Anyways, let's keep playing. I'm sure you'll feel much better after we do.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh... Yeah, right.
I'll go and get ready then!
